stages.name: adult
stages.anchorMethod: Reference stance-center ground point hand registered from the anatomical planted feet in source frame 0; the same stationary sole/hoof pattern is registered by integer translation in a fixed 22px lower-foot ROI. All four frames use one shared source canvas relative to that anatomical anchor and one stageScale. No per-frame bbox centering, weighted foot centroid or resizing.

footprint.supportSelection: Golden toes/webbing RGB r>=100,g>=45,r>g,b<=0.7g, plus one-pixel outline; excludes low feather hem.
footprint.method: Reference frame 0 only: connected support feet in the registered lower-foot region; ellipse center spans the stance extrema and rear/front toe-bottom ground contacts. Same geometry for all idle frames; animal registration and transforms are unchanged.
